# EXCALIBUR Control Center v0.5.2

Patch release. A native Linux **read-only hardware telemetry control center** for
CASPER EXCALIBUR G870 laptops, delivered as a single Arch Linux package
(`excalibur-control-center`) that contains the Qt6 GUI **and** the `excalibur-wmi`
read-only hwmon driver (integrated DKMS).

This release fixes two real defects found during the V1.0 hardening pass. It adds
**no** new capabilities. The product still only reports telemetry — it does not
control any hardware.

## Fixed

- **Diagnostics rebuilt repeatedly after changing the theme.** The telemetry →
  diagnostics connection was re-made on every theme rebuild, so the work multiplied
  with the number of theme switches. It is now established once.
- **History was "60 samples", not "60 seconds".** At the default 2-second refresh
  this meant ~120 seconds of history while the app and the JSON export said 60 s
  (and up to ~600 s at a 10-second refresh). History is now a true rolling
  **60-second** window at every refresh rate, and the Cooling "…s ago" label uses
  real sample timestamps.

## Verified

- CPU / GPU temperature and fan RPM shown exactly as the raw hwmon values
  (no smoothing, averaging, median, clamping or filtering).
- Real-hardware regression on a CASPER EXCALIBUR G870 (NLXB 001): navigation,
  hide/show, theme switching, settings, diagnostics/JSON export, single-instance,
  driver recovery, and long-run resource stability.

## Not supported

There is no fan control, no RGB control, no power control, no performance mode, and
no EC/WMI writes. The application never requires root.

## Known limitations

- **Kernel API compatibility:** the driver is verified against the **7.2.x** kernel
  API. It does **not** build against **6.18.x-lts** because
  `wmidev_set_block` / `wmidev_query_block` are absent there.
- **Telemetry fidelity:** the GUI shows raw hwmon values; anomalous firmware/EC
  samples are not hidden.
- **Secure Boot:** the package neither generates keys nor signs modules; the user
  handles module signing.
- **AUR:** publication is pending registration availability.

## Install (Arch Linux / CachyOS)

The AUR package is not published yet. Until it is available:

- build the package from source (see the repository README), or
- install the release package artifact directly:

  ```bash
  sudo pacman -U excalibur-control-center-0.5.2-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
  ```

The GUI runs without root (unprivileged runtime). Package installation and the DKMS
kernel-module lifecycle may require root.
